https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below are a few well‑known public APIs that accept an IP address (or a domain name) and return business‑related data such as the owning company, contact details, and other metadata.  
All of them expose a simple HTTP GET endpoint that you can call from any programming language or even from a browser.

| Service | What it offers | Typical endpoint | Pricing / limits | Notes |
|---------|----------------|------------------|------------------|-------|
| **ipinfo.io** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json` | Free tier: 50k requests/month, paid plans start at $5/month. | Requires an API token for higher limits. |
| **ipstack.com** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://api.ipstack.com/<IP>?access_key=YOUR_KEY` | Free tier: 10k requests/month, paid plans start at $10/month. | Good for bulk lookups. |
| **ipapi.co** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://ipapi.co/<IP>/json/` | Free tier: 30k requests/month, paid plans start at $9.99/month. | Simple JSON output. |
| **ipgeolocation.io** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_KEY&ip=<IP>` | Free tier: 1k requests/day, paid plans start at $19/month. | Offers additional fields like timezone, currency, etc. |
| **ipwhois.io** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://ipwhois.app/json/<IP>` | Free tier: 10k requests/month, paid plans start at $5/month. | Very lightweight JSON. |
| **ipqualityscore.com** | Company name, domain, organization, ASN, contact email, phone, website, logo, and more. | `https://www.ipqualityscore.com/api/json/ip/<API_KEY>/<IP>` | Free tier: 10k requests/month, paid plans start at $10/month. | Also provides fraud detection. |

### How to use one of them (example with ipinfo.io)

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
     https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json
```

Response (abridged):

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "hostname": "dns.google",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "region": "California",
  "country": "US",
  "loc": "37.3860,-122.0840",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "postal": "94035",
  "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "logo": "https://logo.clearbit.com/google.com",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "email": "support@google.com",
    "website": "https://www.google.com"
  }
}
```

### Things to keep in mind

1. **Rate limits** – Most free tiers allow a few thousand requests per month. If you need higher volume, consider a paid plan or a self‑hosted solution (e.g., using the open‑source `whois` database).
2. **Accuracy** – The data is only as good as the source. Some IPs belong to ISPs or hosting providers rather than a single “company.” In those cases the `company` field may be empty or contain the ISP name.
3. **Privacy** – Some services offer a “privacy mode” that strips personally identifiable information from the response. Use it if you’re dealing with sensitive data.
4. **Caching** – IP ownership rarely changes frequently. Cache the results locally (e.g., Redis, Memcached) to reduce API calls and stay within rate limits.

---

#### Quick comparison table

| Service | Company field | Contact email | Contact phone | Logo URL | Free tier limit |
|---------|---------------|---------------|---------------|----------|-----------------|
| ipinfo.io | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 50k/month |
| ipstack.com | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 10k/month |
| ipapi.co | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 30k/month |
| ipgeolocation.io | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 1k/day |
| ipwhois.io | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 10k/month |
| ipqualityscore.com | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | ✔ | 10k/month |

Pick the one that best matches your volume, budget, and feature needs. If you need a completely free, self‑hosted solution, you can combine the `whois` command line tool with a local database of company registries (e.g., the [OpenCorporates](https://opencorporates.com/) dataset).
